findings.message: `committed_plan` runs `git show HEAD:CHUPA_PLAN.md` whenever `plan is not None`, even when no plan-bound arrival exists. If CHUPA_PLAN.md is in the working tree but not in HEAD (untracked, only staged, or deleted from HEAD), `Git._run` raises GitError. That aborts every drain scan, including drains that have nothing to do with a plan-bound arrival. The merge base read only the working-tree file and tolerated this state.
findings.paved_road: Read the committed plan only when `plan_bound` is true, and treat a missing `HEAD:CHUPA_PLAN.md` as an empty plan (every unit `absent`) instead of letting GitError escape `_scan`.
